verdict.rationale: The evidence shows fixed, built-in event behaviors: automatic product reviews on pull requests, retest on push or an @foreloop comment, and agents polling for approved tasks on a cadence. It does not document any way for users to define their own event-to-action rules. These are adjacent features, not a user-configurable automation rule engine, so the story is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Connect a repository and get automatic product reviews on your pull requests.
Push changes or have a repository writer comment @foreloop retest.
The agent then checks Foreloop for approved tasks on a cadence and works them as they arrive.
